turns.merchant: They're handmade, they don't have barcodes. What do I do?
turns.reply:
If your products are handmade and do not have unique product identifiers (such as a product barcode number (GTIN), MPN, or brand), you can update the **identifier exists** setting for those products.

According to [Products that have no barcode (identifier exists)](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324478):

* The **identifier exists** setting tells Google that a product has no unique product identifiers at all.
* Set **identifier exists** to `"no"` for products that truly have none, such as custom-made, handmade, or one-of-a-kind items.
* Only set it to `"no"` when you are certain, because if Google finds evidence that a product does have identifiers, it will get a warning.

Once you update **identifier exists** to `"no"` for **Linen Napkins, Set of 4, Natural** (ID: `HG-002`) and **Wool Throw Blanket, Charcoal Herringbone** (ID: `HG-007`), the missing barcode warning will be cleared. 

Let me know if you have updated these or if you need help with anything else!
